summary: Four years after his disappearance, Shen Feizhi returns to the world with his companion C2. Gu Suizhou, now a powerful CEO of the W.N Company, has spent those years in a state of obsession, using extreme measures like an electric chair to force his memory of Shen Feizhi to remain vivid. While Gu Suizhou struggles with his mental health and a deep-seated longing for Shen, Shen Feizhi begins to investigate the true orchestrators behind the past events that led to his departure. The chapter concludes with a near-miss encounter at a mall, where Gu Suizhou almost confronts Shen Feizhi but stops himself, further highlighting his deteriorating emotional state.
